posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months. Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. posts.text: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help. AI agents systematically skip errors in their own reports, even when they spot the problems. In a study by Google Research, MIT, and Harvard, GPT-5.5 left out negative results in 198 out of 200 paper abstracts.
